updates.note: Management stated revenue growth guidance is around 7% to 8%, or 8% to 10%
updates.quote: And revenue growth, the guidance is 7% to 8%, whatever is there, we will try to continue with that.

updates.note: Reiterated capex plan of Rs. 14,000 to 15,000 crore for the next 5 years.
updates.quote: we have formulated a comprehensive CAPEX plan for the next five years, with an estimated outlay of Rs. 14,000 to Rs. 15,000 crore.

new_promises.statement: Maintain operating EBITDA margin at around 31% in the medium term.
new_promises.quote: if you remove the interest income, so EBITDA will be around 31%. So, we will be maintaining 31% at operating level.
new_promises.speaker: Barenya Senapati

new_promises.statement: Conclude GE F414 engine deal for Mark-2 in this financial year.
new_promises.quote: we expect that in this financial year; we will be able to come to a conclusion of this deal.
new_promises.speaker: D.K. Sunil

new_promises.statement: Fly the Tejas Mark-2 prototype in the first quarter of next year ('26).
new_promises.quote: we expect to fly the prototype in the next year, 1st Quarter of next year.
new_promises.speaker: D.K. Sunil

new_promises.statement: Complete certification for Tejas Mark-2 in 2029-30.
new_promises.quote: if it starts flying in '26, we expect certification to be completed in '29-30.
new_promises.speaker: D.K. Sunil

new_promises.statement: Reach a production rate of 24 LCA Mark 1A aircraft in FY26-27.
new_promises.speaker: D.K. Sunil

new_promises.statement: Reach a production rate of 30 LCA Mark 1A aircraft in FY27-28.
new_promises.quote: In '27-'28 we will be able to get the full advantage... reach that number of 30.
new_promises.speaker: D.K. Sunil
